assertions.name: me8Gh_not_exact
assertions.source: precision-floor refutation of exactness: the gap must exceed the 1e-45 arithmetic floor by >9 orders. The criterion is the MARGIN over the floor, not a hardcoded gap — the old 1e-4 threshold was sized to the then-observed 6e-4 and reported a FALSE failure once the gap reached 1.68e-5, which is still ~40 orders above floor

assertions.name: dressed_equals_proxy_over_h
assertions.source: numerical cross-check of the exact reduction at q₀

description: Formalize-first on the deuteron 1/h scale: (i) EXACT ℚ(q) reduction Q_β_proxy = E₀·h·(2−h)/2 (sympy-proved) ⟹ Δ_λ(D)=1/h ⟺ B_D = E₀·(1−h/2)·Δtr — the 1/h is the E₀ scale dressed by the smoothed bar-averaged crossing; (ii) Q_β = m_e·8G·h REFUTED-as-exact at the precision floor (0.06% near-match survives as observation); (iii) the zero-fit candidate errors vs AME under both Q_β forms. Nothing wired (Δ_λ gate).

i_exact_reduction.equivalence: Δ_λ(D) = 1/h  ⟺  B_D = E₀·(1 − h/2)·Δtr; the 1/h scale is E₀ dressed by (1 − h/2) = bar-average of the smoothed crossing pair {1, 1−h} (σ⁻¹ = σ − h)
i_exact_reduction.lean_target: generic-[Field R] identity per §7c: field_simp; ring — follow-up bean

ii_exactness_refutation.verdict: REFUTED-as-exact, scope (b) for the EXACT claim only: with exact inputs the gap (-1.682e-5 production / 0.001058 proxy) is 40.2 orders above the 1.0e-45 floor — Q_β = m_e·8G·h is not an identity at q₀. The 0.00168% near-match survives as an observation: E₀·(2−h)/2 ≈ m_e·8G, an algebraic-vs-Catalan transcendental near-coincidence (Weinberg-cosh class). Figures derived, not hardcoded: the previous text quoted ≈6e-4 / 0.06%, which had gone stale by ~37x.

iii_candidate.tier: observation-tier candidate, NOT wired (Δ_λ gate): the (1−h/2) dressing takes the E₀ route from -72.33% to -75.22% (proxy Q_β) / -75.25% (Kashiwara Q_β) against AME2020; wiring requires deriving the dressing from the binding functional
